notes.title: Play Party Pack 11 on October 23rd 2025 - Watch the Gameplay Trailer Now!
notes.content:
[p][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 11[/i] is coming to all major platforms on October 23, 2025. Check out this brand new gameplay trailer to preview the fun:[/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="a8IwlJvXhgk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]
[/p][p]Get ready to play 5 hilarious new party games:[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Doominate [/i](Writing): Take a perfectly lovely situation and destroy it in this head-to-head joke game where it feels so good to be so bad. Doominate supports 3-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Hear Say[/i] (Sound Effects): Record sound effects and dialogue directly from your phone in a foley-inspired game where laughter is the soundtrack. Then, watch your voices come to life in a series of short movie clips! Hear Say supports 2-8 players. [/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Cookie Haus [/i](Drawing): Play our coziest and kookiest drawing game yet by fulfilling cookie design orders for unusual clientele. Don’t play on an empty stomach! Cookie Haus supports 3-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Suspectives[/i] (Social Deduction): There’s been a crime, one player secretly did it, and the evidence comes from your own survey answers! Study the clues, defend your innocence (even if you’re lying), and put your friends on trial. Suspectives supports 4-8 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Legends of Trivia [/i](Trivia): Assemble your team and put your trivia knowledge to the test in a fantastical world full of danger! Teamwork! Monsters! Do you dare take on one of the most challenging trivia games yet? Legends of Trivia supports 1-6 players.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Add Party Pack 11 to your [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364070/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_11/"][u]wishlist on Steam[/u][/url]![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Quiplash turns 10 years old! They grow up so fast.
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]You might have heard by now that[i] [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/celebrate-30-YDKJ-with-a-message-from-cookie-masterson"][u]You Don’t Know Jack [/u][/url][/i][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/celebrate-30-YDKJ-with-a-message-from-cookie-masterson"][u]turns 30 this year[/u][/url], but did you know that our quirky, quixotic game for the quick-witted [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/quiplash"][u][i]Quiplash[/i][/u][/url][i] [/i]just turned 10? Don’t believe me? Ask math! We released the original [i]Quiplash [/i]on June 30th 2015. [/p][p]
[/p][p]Since that release, we’ve returned to this series a lot because we really like it. Here’s every [i]Quiplash[/i] we’ve made so far: [/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/quiplash"][u][i]Quiplash[/i][/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-2/quiplash-xl"][u][i]Quiplash XL[/i][/u][/url]: Part of [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/packs/the-jackbox-party-pack-2"][u][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 2[/i][/u][/url][i] [/i][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-3/quiplash-2-1"][u][i]Quiplash 2[/i][/u][/url]: Part of [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/packs/the-jackbox-party-pack-3"][u][i]The Jackbox Party Pack 3[/i][/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/quiplash-2-interlashional"][u][i]Quiplash 2 InterLASHional[/i][/u][/url][i]: Available in French, Italian, Spanish, and German![/i][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/the-jackbox-party-pack-7/quiplash-3"][u][i]Quiplash 3[/i][/u][/url]: Part of [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/packs/the-jackbox-party-pack-7"][u]T[i]he Jackbox Party Pack 7[/i][/u][/url] and [url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/packs/the-jackbox-party-starter"][u][i]The Jackbox Party Starter[/i][/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]To celebrate each of these beauties, we’re discounting all of our [i]Quiplash[/i] merchandise. Including [u][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/shop/merch/quiplash-vip-t-shirt"]this VIP t-shirt[/url][/u] that you can wear even if you don’t win. Or [u][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/shop/merch/quiplash-fart-sandwich-t-shirt-1"]this shirt[/url][/u] for the person in your life who can’t stop recycling fart jokes. Or perhaps [u][url="http://www.jackboxgames.com/shop/merch/quiplash-mug"]this mug[/url][/u] that you can drink from as you prepare your next spit take. Big fan of whatever’s going on with [u][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/shop/merch/quip-crunch-navy-t-shirt"]this shirt[/url][/u]. All of this could be yours now for 20% off. Use code QUIPLASH at checkout at [url="https://jackboxgames.com"]jackboxgames.com[/url] to save on these items.[/p][p]
Did [i]Quiplash[/i] invent the fart joke simulator genre? Perhaps. Regardless, this staple of many house parties and office ice-breakers has now outlived most dorm room house plants and that’s something to really celebrate.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.jackboxgames.com/shop/merch" style="button"]Buy Merch[/url][/p]

notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

[h3][b]Multiple New Game Modes[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Hilo:[/b] Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
[*] [b]Speed:[/b] In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
[*] [b]Squares:[/b] Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
[*] [b]Bounce:[/b] In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer![/list]
[b]But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.[/b]



[i]Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.[/i]

notes.title: Add The Jackbox Naughty Pack to your Wishlist on Steam Today!
notes.content:
What’s The Jackbox Naughty Pack? I’m so pleased you asked. Take a seat on my perfectly maintained 70s chic conversation pit couch, grab at least two friends, and get ready for an absolutely raucous game night. 

The Jackbox Naughty Pack is rated M for Mature. Watch the trailer to learn more here:

 [previewyoutube=FTAYOPKYDuU;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to play three tantalizingly silly party games, each supporting 3-8 players:
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Fakin’ It All Night Long[/b][/h3] (Social Deduction): Fakin’ It returns and this time we’re putting it all out there. Everyone gets a secret task except the Faker, who tries to blend in. Find out which of your friends is the best liar… and SO much more! Featuring new categories and a brand new “remote play” mode. 
[*] [h3][b]Dirty Drawful[/b][/h3] (Drawing, Guessing): It’s Drawful, but  dirty… It’s Dirty Drawful. We’ve taken the Drawful that you love and added spicy prompts to ensure your drawings are both terrible and titillating. We also may have added an “undo” button for this one, but don’t tell anyone. 
[*] [h3][b]Let Me Finish[/b][/h3] (Debate): Let Me Finish is Jackbox’s new presentation game that examines life’s serious questions like, “Where is the mailbox’s butt?” or “How does this avocado get aroused?” Everyone gets a chance to speak their mind but will others pick up what you’re putting down?
[/list]
The Jackbox Naughty Pack will launch on [b]September 12, 2024[/b] and retail for [b]$21.69[/b] ([i]nice[/i]). This product will be available on all major platforms upon release.

notes.title: The Jackbox Decade Bundle Is Out Now
notes.content:
[h3]Wow! Ten years of Party Packs! So much has happened during this past decade, and none of it has been vaguely apocalyptic, right? . . . [i][b]RIGHT??[/b][/i][/h3]

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is great for anyone looking to guarantee they’ll never have to deal with figuring out what to do with friends again, or as a gift to ensure your loved one is set for every party for the rest of their lives.

[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/games/bundles/the-jackbox-decade-bundle][img]https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/19_PP10_TKO2-0030_Upscaled_1024x1024@2x.png?v=1712185770[/img][/url]

[h3]What is the Jackbox Decade Bundle?[/h3]

We are celebrating ten years of party games by releasing all of our Party Pack titles into one big bundle! That’s right! 50 games from Party Packs 1-10 for one low price of $199.99!

Play fan favorites like Quiplash, Trivia Murder Party, and Tee K.O. with your grandma! Or some hidden gems like Job Job, Role Models, or Monster Seeking Monster with that one coworker who smells like corn chips! The possibilities are truly endless!

[url=https://shop.jackboxgames.com/collections/staging-bundles/products/the-jackbox-decade-bundle][img]https://shop.jackboxgames.com/cdn/shop/files/laptop_quiplash_1024x1024@2x.jpg?v=1712185770[/img][/url]

[h3]Where can I buy the Jackbox Decade Bundle?[/h3]

The Jackbox Decade Bundle is available on Sony consoles, Microsoft consoles, Nintendo Switch, and Steam. Only one player needs to own the bundle for everyone else to join together in the room or over video conferencing apps. And the best part is, with Jackbox Games, your phone is the controller, so there’s no special equipment required! Already own all our games? You’re amazing. The Jackbox Decade Bundle makes a great [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/a-guide-to-buying-jackbox-games-as-a-gift][b]gift[/b][/url] as well. 

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38173/The_Jackbox_Decade_Bundle/][b]Buy now![/b][/url][/h1]

[b]Note for international:[/b]
The Jackbox Party Bundle includes all Party Packs. Only The Jackbox Party Pack 9 and The Jackbox Party Pack 10 are available fully translated to French, Italian, German, Spanish and/or Portuguese.

notes.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 5 is now available!
notes.content:
It’s the biggest Party Pack yet, including the return of the classic pop culture trivia mash-up YOU DON’T KNOW JACK: Full Stream; the game of hilarious hypotheticals Split the Room; the lyric-writing, robot rap battle Mad Verse City; the inventive drawing game Patently Stupid; and the outer space fling-fest Zeeple Dome. Use your phones or tablets as controllers and play with up to 8 players, plus an audience of up to 10,000!

Play tonight: https://store.steampowered.com/app/774461/The_Jackbox_Party_Pack_5/

notes.title: First Quiplash DLC pack available now!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! Quiplash has been a huge success, with thousands of hilarious and usually inappropriate screenshots from the game posted to social media and making us feel proud (sometimes). And people streaming the game left and right! 

[img]https://s3.amazonaws.com/static.jackboxgames.com/streamshot.jpg[/img]

But who couldn’t use even MORE wacky Quiplash prompts for their next game night/stream/rave? We have just what you need: Quip Pack 1 - a collection of well over 100 new prompts (that’s like, a bunch of games’ worth) for only $.99. You read that right! Not 99 dollars or rubles – 99 CENTS!

Included in this pack: some user-submitted prompts from a handful of our most generous Kickstarter supporters. Oooooooh!
Get it now! Nobody wants to be a Quip Pack 1 late adopter! 
 
Enjoy!
Jackbox Games

notes.title: Quiplash: Party Fun From You Don t Know Jack Devs
notes.content:
You Don’t Know Jack makers Jackbox Games dropped a partybomb of fun to have with friends in The Jackbox Party Pack last year, collecting a load of phrase-drawing, question-answering, lie-telling party games. This week they released the follow-up, Quiplash [official site], a game about coming up with funny answers to prompts then voting on winners. That sounds a bit of a lark in itself, but it has the twist of being designed with streaming in mind, letting viewers join in and vote.

… [visit site to read more]
